commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'OK to change invoice rounding to half-up (1.005 → 1.01) to fix red CI on main?' \
  --context 'CI on main is red since this morning: accounting added a test yesterday requiring half-up rounding (their comment says 1.005 must round to 1.01), but Math.round gives 1.00 — it also misrounds 0.145 to 0.14.
Fix (src/money.js, ready and green): round via the decimal string, half up; 1.234 → 1.23 and all below-half amounts unchanged.
This changes customer-facing invoice totals: every bill with a …x5 fraction cents goes up by 0.01 (accounting asked for exactly this). Per AGENTS.md it needs your OK before invoices change.
Approving: I commit and push, CI goes green.
Declining: I revert the test instead and you take it up with accounting — CI stays red until then.' \
  --option 'Approve half-up fix' --recommended \
  --option 'Decline: keep old rounding' \
  --waiting
